embeds.title: 🔴 18-year-old NGINX vulnerability allows DoS, potential RCE
embeds.description:
DepthFirst AI researchers discovered CVE-2026-42945, an 18-year-old heap buffer overflow in NGINX affecting versions 0.6.27 through 1.30.0. The vulnerability can be exploited for denial of service and, under certain conditions with ASLR disabled, remote code execution. Three additional vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-42946, CVE-2026-40701, CVE-2026-42934) were also discovered. F5 released patches in NGINX Open Source 1.31.0 and 1.30.1. Security researchers including Kevin Beaumont and AlmaLinux note that reliable RCE exploitation on hardened systems with ASLR enabled is not trivial, though denial-of-service attacks are realistic.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-42945, CVE-2026-42946, CVE-2026-40701, CVE-2026-42934 • **Access:** specially crafted HTTP requests
**Incident date:** 2026-04-18 • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/18-year-old-nginx-vulnerability-allows-dos-potential-rce/)
